title: A custom liveness URL retains liveness-only membership
summary: Reads the canonical liveness group, its alias and overall HTTP health while a separately registered indicator changes state.

subject.symbol: Actuator liveness group, alias and overall HTTP health

change.description: Customizing a probe group’s path while leaving include and exclude unset now retains the probe’s default members. Explicit membership remains effective.

notes: Both sides use the same recorded MVC transport and dependencies from S33. The S31 and S33-fix MVC main source trees agree. The health implementation and its owning dependencies come first from each original S31 deployment.
